title: Americas · breeds of the new world
blurb: The breeds invented in the United States and Canada: the Maine Coon, the Ragdoll, the Sphynx and the wild hybrids of the last fifty years.

items.d: America's largest native breed: 4–8 kg, a shaggy coat, a raccoon tail and a friendly dog-like manner.
The working cat of the American farm and ship, standardised as a sturdy, even-tempered shorthair.
A pointed longhair bred in California in the 1960s, known for going limp when lifted.
A leopard-cat hybrid from the 1960s, with rosettes, a glittering coat and a lot of energy.
A serval cross first bred in 1986: tall, long-legged and the largest domestic cat allowed in many countries.
The hairless cat of Canada, 1966: warm skin, a pot belly and no coat to shed.
A breed from California, 1981, defined by ears that curl back instead of standing up.
The short-legged cat of the 1980s, with normal-sized body and a low-slung walk.
